name: Choice Chews | 200mg Gummies | Granddaddy Grape
description: Indulge in the rich, calming taste of Choice Chews' Grandaddy Purple gummies. Infused with an indica blend, these gummies offer a luscious mix of grape and berry flavors, bringing a soothing, yet invigorating experience that makes relaxation effortless.
